items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The two added lines `if auth: netloc = '@'.join([auth, netloc])` are clear and follow the existing style. There is no comment explaining why it is needed (the reference has one), but that is a minor documentation gap.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: This is a minimal two-line change that reuses the `auth` value parse_url already returns. It adds no new helpers, dead code or debug leftovers.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: It is guarded by `if auth:`, so URLs without credentials are untouched. It adds no magic constants and swallows no errors. Hidden tests pass (F2P 2/2, P2P 185/185).

items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
items.name_zh: prepend_scheme_if_needed 其他公开行为不变
items.evidence: The signature is unchanged and only parse_url's `auth` is re-attached to netloc. There is no urllib3 pinning or Python-version check, and the code matches the reference.
